is_new_passive_user.meaning: the claimant is a new user who staked TRUST purely for yield and did not interact with the MultiVault

is_first_claim.meaning: the claimant is making their first claim

raw_utilization_delta.meaning: rawUtilizationDelta computed for the new passive user's first epoch

applied_lower_bound.meaning: personalUtilizationLowerBound applied to the first claim (report default 2500, i.e. 25%)

basis_points_divisor.meaning: BASIS_POINTS_DIVISOR, the penalty-free utilization value the first claim should return

assumptions: The first claim is the claim in which the user's prior-epoch claimable amount was zero, matching the report's first-claim exemption scenario.
personalUtilizationLowerBound is the value actually applied to the first claim's yield computation.

unresolved.description: Report does not give the numeric value of BASIS_POINTS_DIVISOR; it is bound symbolically as the penalty-free utilization value the first claim should return.
Report does not state whether the first claim is permissionless or restricted to the account owner; caller scope is left unconstrained.

limitations: Only the v_yield_slashed impact (applied personalUtilizationLowerBound of 2500/25%) is formalized; the separate potential 75% destruction impact is not covered by this plan.
The relation is stated at the applied-lower-bound level; the exact yield amount reduction is not modeled because the report gives no yield formula.
